measurement_description: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It evaluates Large Language Models (LLMs) on their ability to make moral judgments and provide reasoning for complex, everyday moral dilemmas sourced from the 'Am I the Asshole' (AITA) community on Reddit. The evaluation is based on a moral framework of six themes: Fairness & Proportionality, Feelings, Harm & Offense, Honesty, Relational Obligation, and Social Norms.
